text: The company does not use MFA, has outdated Windows systems, and performs backups once a month.
We use multi-factor authentication everywhere, have a firewall and antivirus on all PCs, and take daily backups.
There is no firewall and we have no incident response plan. Staff have never had security training.
We have a written security policy and run phishing drills. We have 40 employees.
No backups are taken and we do not use a VPN.
